item.text: The chime is removed, and all 138 unit and static checks pass. The full browser suite is running now. The formatting check also found existing issues in three untouched test files; the changed game file passed.

Type checking and the production build pass. The browser checks have confirmed keyboard play, screen-reader status updates, and mismatch timing. They’re running on the exact tool versions named in the project README.
The browser test for silent play passed through a complete game, including the final pair. Snapshot export, Resume, focus handling, and reproduction controls have also passed so far.
The browser checks are still passing, including Restart during a mismatch, New Game, and keyboard navigation on larger boards. I’m letting the remaining regression checks finish.
Saved scores and preferences pass their reload checks. Complete games also pass with keyboard controls and phone taps, and the built game works offline. No browser failures have appeared.
The regression suite remains green. It has also confirmed snapshot timing, board-code loading, touch input after scrolling, and the layout checks completed so far.
